company.shortDescription: BRINC Drones develops technology that enhances public safety, focusing on hardware, software, and services for emergency responders.
company.description: BRINC Drones develops technology that enhances public safety, focusing on hardware, software, and services for emergency responders. The company's drones enable first responders to communicate in real time with individuals during incidents, facilitating crisis management and de-escalation.

productsAndServices.description: Large outdoor emergency-response drone designed for continuous public-safety operations, including automated dispatch, long-range surveillance, thermal imaging, communications, and delivery of emergency payloads.
productsAndServices.name: BRINC Guardian

productsAndServices.description: A purpose-built 911 response drone for on-demand public-safety awareness, with 4G teleoperations, visual and thermal cameras, two-way communications, obstacle avoidance, and emergency payload delivery.
productsAndServices.name: BRINC Responder

productsAndServices.description: A browser-based drone operations platform for teleoperation, dispatch, live streaming, communications, fleet management, mapping, integrations, and CJIS-oriented evidence storage.
productsAndServices.name: BRINC LiveOps

productsAndServices.description: An automated outdoor drone station that launches, lands, recharges, and supports Guardian operations for continuous public-safety response across broad service areas.
productsAndServices.name: BRINC Guardian Station

productsAndServices.description: An indoor tactical drone for scouting hazardous or inaccessible environments, with 4K, night-vision, and thermal imaging, two-way communications, LiDAR mapping, and a glass-breaker attachment.
productsAndServices.name: BRINC Lemur 2

productsAndServices.description: A compact charging and deployment station for Responder drones that supports rapid launch, autonomous return, recharging, weather protection, and integration with public-safety dispatch and operations systems.
productsAndServices.name: BRINC Responder Station
